mutants.name: assert-3-sibling-only
mutants.why: Thread 368: check_assert_3 must resolve the fold baseline through resolve_fold_baseline (the manifest's fold_baseline: line first), not just the sibling beside the plan. Reverting to sibling-only lookup means a declared absolute baseline is ignored, and t1's plan (no sibling, declared gov/ baseline) gets FAIL instead of PASS.
mutants.replacement: _s = plan_path.parent / f".{plan_path.name}.foldcheck.json"; baseline_path = _s if _s.exists() else None
